// The Rust oracle that wrote testdata/objects/*.rust.json and *.rust.err.
//
// Not compiled by any build: it is kept so the goldens can be regenerated
// while the Rust crate exists. Put it at src/main.rs of a scratch crate
// outside the workspace, with Cargo.lock copied from the repository root:
//
//   [dependencies]
//   kuben-crd = { path = "<repo>/crates/kuben-crd" }
//   serde_json = "1"
//   serde = "1"
//
// then run `cargo run --offline -- <repo>/go/kubenapi/v1alpha1/testdata/objects`.
// For every <kind>-<name>.in.json it decodes the object with the Rust type
// and writes what serde_json encodes back (<name>.rust.json), or the decode
// error (<name>.rust.err).

use std::{fs, path::Path};
use kuben_crd::*;
use serde::{de::DeserializeOwned, Serialize};

fn run<T: DeserializeOwned + Serialize>(text: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let v: T = serde_json::from_str(text).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut s = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    s.push('\n');
    Ok(s)
}

fn main() {
    let dir = std::env::args().nth(1).expect("dir");
    let mut names: Vec<_> = fs::read_dir(&dir).unwrap().map(|e| e.unwrap().file_name().into_string().unwrap()).collect();
    names.sort();
    for name in names {
        let Some(stem) = name.strip_suffix(".in.json") else { continue };
        let text = fs::read_to_string(Path::new(&dir).join(&name)).unwrap();
        let kind = stem.split('-').next().unwrap();
        let out = match kind {
            "kubenconfig" => run::<KubenConfig>(&text),
            "project" => run::<Project>(&text),
            "environment" => run::<Environment>(&text),
            "app" => run::<App>(&text),
            "release" => run::<Release>(&text),
            "buildrun" => run::<BuildRun>(&text),
            "applicationruntime" => run::<ApplicationRuntime>(&text),
            "executiontask" => run::<ExecutionTask>(&text),
            other => panic!("kind {other}"),
        };
        match out {
            Ok(s) => fs::write(Path::new(&dir).join(format!("{stem}.rust.json")), s).unwrap(),
            Err(e) => { println!("{stem}: REJECTED: {e}"); let _ = fs::write(Path::new(&dir).join(format!("{stem}.rust.err")), e + "\n"); }
        }
    }
}
